parameter_meanings.HL: torsion angle between L1 and H1 looking down centroid vector C
parameter_meanings.HC1: bend angle between H1 and C
parameter_meanings.LC1: bend angle between L1 and C
parameter_meanings.HC2: bend angle between H2 and C
parameter_meanings.LC2: bend angle between L2 and C

orientation_definition.alignment: Bio.PDB Superimposer of coreset CA onto ABangle consensus H/L (not TMalign in this code path)

software.name: ABangle
software.installation: vendor at VHL-ANGLE/vendor/ABangle (git 5283cd39); import via sys.path
